headline: Binəqədi district offers wide transport connectivity with lower price metrics

tags.reason: heyet_evi price is AZN 862/m², which is below the median of Baku districts at AZN 1,264.5/m².
park indicator is 7.66 per 10,000 residents and natural terrain consists of foothills.

summary: Binəqədi district has a population of 309,200 across 101.2 km² with a density of 2,378 residents per km². The area provides 5 metro stations and 234 bus stops, achieving a neqliyyat index of 75 compared to the Baku districts median of 55.5. Paved road share is 65.1%, which is lower than the median of 83.1%. The listings sample contains 8,254 units with a deed share of 76% and a mortgage share of 37%.
strengths: Transport connectivity is robust with 7.57 bus stops per 10,000 residents, exceeding the Baku districts median of 6.22.
Grocery store density stands at 15.23 per 10,000 residents, compared to the median of 13.41.
New build apartment prices average AZN 2,165/m², slightly under the median of AZN 2,295/m².
weaknesses: Road infrastructure score is constrained by a paved roads share of 65.1% against the median of 83.1%.
Healthcare index is 46, which is lower than the Baku districts median of 51.5.
Education index reaches 38, lagging behind the median of 49.
best_for: Buyers seeking lower priced heyet_evi properties at AZN 862/m².
Residents requiring access to 5 metro stations within the district.
watch_out: Torpaq price is listed as 'mock' at AZN 20,000/sot, meaning it is a demo value and not an estimated market price.
Surface unknown percentage for roads is 82.5%, indicating incomplete mapping data for road surfaces.
confidence_note: OSM coverage is high and per capita metrics are reliable. Price data is based on sample listings, while land prices are mock demo values.
